_comment: THE ONE PART OF MEDOS_TRAINING_ENVIRONMENT THAT IS A DEPLOYMENT DECISION.
MOS-IMG-045 makes the PreprocessingSpec the registered artifact a run is fitted
against, and MOS-TRAIN-124 binds its id, version and digest into the run. Which
spec a deployment trains a capability against is a choice a deployment makes, so
it is declared here -- but the DIGEST is not declared, it is COMPUTED by
medos_trainer.environment from the spec document named below. A hand-written
digest is register entry 82's defect in a second place: correct until somebody
edits the spec, silently false afterwards, and false inside the binding.
`spec_document` is resolved against the image's own copy of the shared package.
ships for a label capability: MOS-IMG-054's self-test executes it end to end and
MOS-TRAIN-133 pins its golden hashes, so it is the one spec on this deployment that
is known to be executable rather than merely well-formed. A site with a registered
spec of its own points `spec_document` at a file instead.
OUTPUT KIND IS DECLARED RATHER THAN DERIVED, and MOS-TRAIN-211 is why: it keys the
default-backend rule on io.output_kind, so the value has to be readable beside the
spec rather than guessed from a capability's output list.
